answer: Locks are recorded in ivory, expire in mesa, and quill lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 68 aliases as a result needs 163 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4681 identities would post 4555 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
